ns2:course.label: Graduate Level Piano
ns2:course.description: Study at the graduate level in piano; selected studies from the masterworks in piano literature. Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the appropriate Keyboard faculty. May be repeated to a maximum of 20 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music, or successful completion of a qualifying audition for the appropriate Keyboard faculty.
